summary: Defines a Diameter application and command codes that allow a peer's capabilities to be updated dynamically while the connection stays open. This avoids tearing down a connection just to change what a peer supports. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: Normally if you learn a new skill, you would have to leave the room to tell everyone. This lets you announce it right there without leaving the conversation.

questions: change diameter peer capabilities without reconnecting
